| Average budget for AI consulting (SMB) | $5,000 – $15,000 per engagement | Clutch.co / Thumbtack Business Services |

### 4. Industry-Specific AI Benchmarks for Consulting / SaaS
| Metric | Value | Source |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Avg consulting engagement value (AI vertical) | $18k – $45k | IBISWorld "AI Consulting" 2024 |
| AI consulting market growth rate (CAGR) | 32% (2023-2030) | Grand View Research |
| SaaS companies using AI in product | 68% | Bessemer Cloud Index 2024 |
| Consulting firms offering AI readiness services | 74% of top 100 firms | Gartner Consulting Market Analysis 2024 |
| Customer success rate of AI pilots (SMB) | 55% achieve production | McKinsey "State of AI 2024" |
| Average time to value from AI consulting | 3–6 months | Deloitte AI Institute |
| Common pricing model | Fixed-fee assessment + hourly/milestone implementation | Upwork / Catalant |
